not_applicable.loading: ‘searching’ is the loading state: the card spins while the browser’s list of bikes is open.
not_applicable.empty: The supported bikes list is fixed, and a search that finds nothing is the browser’s own chooser.
not_applicable.error: The failures are their own states: bluetooth-off, unsupported-browser, needs-https, chooser-blocked and chooser-failed.

not_applicable.loading: Telo Ride 1 has one class, bundled with the app; nothing loads before the page shows. The video player fills its box when YouTube answers.
not_applicable.empty: There is always the one class. A rider with no rides yet is the default state, which simply has no stats.
not_applicable.error: The failures are their own states: no-bike, video-unavailable, cannot-draw, needs-chromium, needs-https and cannot-load.

not_applicable.loading: The ride starts from The Class with the bike already connected and the plan in memory; there is nothing to wait for.
not_applicable.empty: A ride always has its plan, its clock and the bike’s readings.
not_applicable.error: The one failure during a ride is losing the bike: the disconnected state.

not_applicable.loading: The result is computed on the device when the class ends; the page has it before it opens.
not_applicable.empty: Class Done only opens after a ride, so it always has an output and eight efforts.
not_applicable.error: Telo Ride 1 saves the ride on the device and sends it nowhere, so there is no failure to show.

not_applicable.empty: The page is itself the empty answer to an address with no screen.
not_applicable.error: The page is itself the error.
